title: Hearty Russian White Bean Wrap
description: A dense and flavorful Russian dish featuring dried white beans, wrapped in a ti leaf, perfect for a satisfying lunch. This vegan-friendly wrap is a show-off dish that is sure to impress.
instructions: Rinse the soaked white beans and cook them in a large pot of boiling water until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, carrot, and mushroom until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked white beans to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface and spoon about 1/2 cup of the bean and vegetable mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
